description.narrative: Groupe de Recherche Action Droit de l'Enfant Mali (GRADEM) is an organization for the promotion and protection of children's fundamental rights, under Receipt N° 119/MATCL-DNI of June 29, 2010Framework Agreement N° 001506 of October 24, 2018 GRADEM is anon-profitorganization. It is designated child any person under 18 years of age (CDE) Vision Every child, girl as well as boy, regardless of origin, race, religion, ethnicity, grows up in a political, social and family environment that protects and promotes his rights and dignity. He/she will blossom and become a full-fledged citizen, responsible and a bearer of peace for a better future. Objectives GRADEM's objectives are the development of an environment more protective of children's rights and, through this, the integral growth of all children. Mission To contribute to the development of a protective environment that promotes and guarantees the fundamental rights of children and women. All children must grow up free and in peace, preferably within their families, which are the fundamental unit of society and the natural environment for the growth and well-being of children and youth. Every child must have access to the satisfaction of his or her vital needs, in a climate of happiness, love and understanding, in order to be able to develop his orher personality harmoniously. Every child needs special protection, in particular adequate legal protection, and appropriate care. The mobilization of the community is indispensable for the respectand the application of the rights of the child. In this perspective, we bring a sustainable and effective contribution through concrete actions aimed at children, women, political authorities, public services and civil society. The project consists in building the capacities of 30 young female household helpers on female empowerment: public speaking, leadership, self-confidence, advocacy etc. The mobilization of more than 1500 young female household helperswho will be informed and sensitized on labor law and the stakes for the improvement of working and living conditions. Among the trained girls, the best ones will be selected as "ambassadors" of the voiceless, in order to be protagonists of their development, therefore to have an ease in speaking,tointervene by making sure that the message is synthetic and punchy, to develop their self-confidence and their capacity to adapt to the audience; to communicate with clarity and conviction These capacities are supported by the synergy of child labor protection actors in a network and by the mobilization of civil society to influence decision-makers to improvemeasures to protect the rights of children in the worst forms of labor. Vulgarize lessons learned with others.

participating-org.narrative: Founded as an NGO under the name GRADEM in 2010 based in Mali. GRADEM contributes in the creation of a more protective environment of the child's rights and especially of the girls in Mali. Her vision is inclusive and promotes equal access to human right. All child, girl as boy, regardless of his origin, his race, his religion, or his ethnic group, grows in a political, social and domestic environment that protects and promotes rights and dignity. He blooms and becomes responsible citizen and carrier of peace to better future. The main activities of the organization carry among others Advocacy for application efficient of the legal texts protecting the child's rights, especially of the girl. Also sustain the creation and work in networks for the prevention of the abuse against the children, of the sexual exploitation (specifically the girls).
